cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Committee,

I am a computer engineer and lecturer who has spent the last few years building NLP systems that are explainable and ready for real use. In my PhD work I created hybrid evaluation metrics for Turkish text summarisation, combining extractive methods with large language models. That required building embedding-based retrieval pipelines, ranking models and custom evaluation datasets, the same core skills you list for classification, ranking and personalisation.

At Toros University I led a research centre where we delivered AI prototypes for medical text analysis. I designed data pipelines, trained deep models in Python and measured accuracy, latency and inference cost across multiple experiments. My recent publications on trustworthy AI and LLM-as-a-judge show I keep up with transformer models and fine-tuning techniques.

Beyond research I have coordinated international projects and mentored students, which taught me how to turn user feedback into concrete model improvements. While I have not yet deployed a model at massive scale, I have built end-to-end training and evaluation workflows that are production-ready.

I look forward to bringing my hands-on AI experience and my focus on reliable, user-centric systems to Actcareers.

Best regards,
Anıl Kuş
